description: Read a wallet's results for one tax year from the chain and return a public, signed link (https://papertax.xyz/v/…) with a share image, for posting on X or anywhere else. Free, and nothing is stored. Dollar amounts are included only when amounts is true. With private true (the default) the wallet address is left out of the link and the page; with private false the page shows it, so check with the user first. It proves what the wallet did, not who owns it.

amounts.description: Include net result, gains, losses and fees

jurisdiction.description: Used when tax_year is not given. AU = 1 Jul–30 Jun; US, CA, JP and ES = calendar year; UK = 6 Apr–5 Apr; NZ = 1 Apr–31 Mar

private.description: Leave the wallet address out of the link and page

tax_year.description: Tax year. AU-2027 = Australia · FY 2026–27; AU-2026 = Australia · FY 2025–26; US-2026 = United States · 2026; US-2025 = United States · 2025; UK-2027 = United Kingdom · 2026–27; UK-2026 = United Kingdom · 2025–26; CA-2026 = Canada · 2026; CA-2025 = Canada · 2025; NZ-2027 = New Zealand · 2026–27; NZ-2026 = New Zealand · 2025–26; JP-2026 = Japan · 2026; JP-2025 = Japan · 2025; ES-2026 = Spain · 2026; ES-2025 = Spain · 2025. Defaults by jurisdiction: AU AU-2026, US US-2026, UK UK-2026, CA CA-2026, NZ NZ-2027, JP JP-2026, ES ES-2026.

name: create_verified_pnl
title: Create a verified PnL link
